description_en: Modifies the configuration of a VPC firewall that protects traffic between network instances in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) and a specified VPC
description_zh: 修改VPC边界防火墙（防护云企业网内的网络实例和指定VPC之间的互访流量）的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw modify-vpc-firewall-cen-configure --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --vpc-firewall-name Test_instance --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVpcFirewallCenConfigure
